list.name: client
list.label: Client
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT name AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM t_org_clients ORDER BY __text

list.name: area
list.label: Area
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT area AS __text, area AS __value FROM t_sys_analytics_taxonomy ORDER BY __text

list.name: feature
list.label: Feature
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT feature AS __text, feature AS __value FROM t_sys_analytics_taxonomy WHERE ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') ORDER BY __text

list.name: sub_feature
list.label: Sub-feature
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT sub_feature AS __text, sub_feature AS __value FROM t_sys_analytics_taxonomy WHERE sub_feature IS NOT NULL AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR feature = '${feature}') ORDER BY __text

list.name: role
list.label: Role
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT role FROM t_analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY role

panels.title: Most visited areas
panels.description: Top-level areas ranked by page-visit count. One visit = one route-level entry into the area; internal tab switches within a page do NOT inflate this count (see the Nested tabs panel for those).

targets.rawSql: SELECT area, COUNT(*)::int AS visits FROM t_analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR client_id::text = '${client}') AND role ~ '^${role:regex}$' AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR feature = '${feature}') AND ('${sub_feature}' = 'All' OR sub_feature = '${sub_feature}') AND sub_feature IS NULL GROUP BY area ORDER BY visits DESC

panels.title: Most visited features
panels.description: Pages / features people actually open, counted as page visits only. Tab switches inside a page do NOT inflate this count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT area || ' → ' || feature AS page, COUNT(*)::int AS visits FROM t_analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR client_id::text = '${client}') AND role ~ '^${role:regex}$' AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR feature = '${feature}') AND ('${sub_feature}' = 'All' OR sub_feature = '${sub_feature}') AND sub_feature IS NULL GROUP BY area, feature ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Most visited nested tabs (sub-features)
panels.description: Deepest level — which tabs inside a feature people actually open. Rows only appear when a sub_feature is recorded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT area || ' → ' || feature || ' → ' || sub_feature AS tab, COUNT(*)::int AS visits FROM t_analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR client_id::text = '${client}') AND role ~ '^${role:regex}$' AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR feature = '${feature}') AND ('${sub_feature}' = 'All' OR sub_feature = '${sub_feature}') AND sub_feature IS NOT NULL GROUP BY area, feature, sub_feature ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Usage by role
panels.description: Which roles produce the traffic. Default is all roles across every env; narrow with the Role dropdown above, or set analytics.tracked_roles on a client to opt-out / restrict.

targets.rawSql: SELECT role, COUNT(*)::int AS visits FROM t_analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR client_id::text = '${client}') AND role ~ '^${role:regex}$' AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR feature = '${feature}') AND ('${sub_feature}' = 'All' OR sub_feature = '${sub_feature}') GROUP BY role ORDER BY visits DESC

panels.title: Usage by client
panels.description: One row per client. `active_users` counts distinct user_id in the window — a truer signal of adoption than raw event count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.name AS client, COUNT(*)::int AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT ae.user_id)::int AS active_users FROM t_analytics_events ae JOIN t_org_clients c ON c.id = ae.client_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ae.event_time) AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR ae.client_id::text = '${client}') AND ae.role ~ '^${role:regex}$' AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR ae.area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR ae.feature = '${feature}') AND ('${sub_feature}' = 'All' OR ae.sub_feature = '${sub_feature}') GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY events DESC

panels.title: Zero / low-usage features (last window)
panels.description: Every declared taxonomy triplet — area, feature, sub_feature — that recorded ZERO events in the window. LEFT JOIN over t_sys_analytics_taxonomy so page-view rows (sub_feature IS NULL) AND deeper tab rows (sub_feature set) are both accountable. Filter predicates live in the ON clause so the join stays a true LEFT JOIN under narrower time / client / role selections.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.area, t.feature, COALESCE(t.sub_feature, '(page-view)') AS sub_feature FROM t_sys_analytics_taxonomy t LEFT JOIN t_analytics_events e ON e.area = t.area AND e.feature = t.feature AND ((t.sub_feature IS NULL AND e.sub_feature IS NULL) OR e.sub_feature = t.sub_feature) AND $__timeFilter(e.event_time) AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR e.client_id::text = '${client}') AND e.role ~ '^${role:regex}$' WHERE e.area IS NULL AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR t.area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR t.feature = '${feature}') AND ('${sub_feature}' = 'All' OR COALESCE(t.sub_feature, '') = '${sub_feature}') ORDER BY t.area, t.feature, t.sub_feature NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Area transitions (top flows)
panels.description: For each session, the sequence of areas a user moved through. Reveals real navigation paths — where users actually go after landing on an area, not where we intended. Uses LEAD() over session_id ordered by event_time; same-area consecutive events are collapsed. Requires the `netsage-sankey-panel` plugin (installed via docker-compose GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS).

targets.rawSql: WITH ordered AS (SELECT session_id, area, event_time, LEAD(area) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time) AS next_area FROM t_analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR client_id::text = '${client}') AND role ~ '^${role:regex}$' AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR feature = '${feature}') AND ('${sub_feature}' = 'All' OR sub_feature = '${sub_feature}')) SELECT area AS source, next_area AS target, COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM ordered WHERE next_area IS NOT NULL AND area <> next_area GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Peak hours — hour × weekday
panels.description: When users actually work. Rows = weekday (Mon → Sun), columns = hour-of-day in the tenant's browser timezone. Deeper colour = more events. Use to time cron jobs, deploys, maintenance windows. Requires the `marcusolsson-hourly-heatmap-panel` plugin (installed via docker-compose GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS) — Grafana's native heatmap only supports time on the X axis and cannot render a real hour-of-day × day-of-week grid.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_time) AS time, COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM t_analytics_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${client}' = 'All' OR client_id::text = '${client}') AND role ~ '^${role:regex}$' AND ('${area}' = 'All' OR area = '${area}') AND ('${feature}' = 'All' OR feature = '${feature}') AND ('${sub_feature}' = 'All' OR sub_feature = '${sub_feature}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
